<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>BJP Rajya Sabha reshuffle:</strong> The BJP has nominated eight new candidates for the Rajya Sabha from Uttar Pradesh, dropping two ministers including Hardeep Puri, in a move aimed at caste and regional balancing ahead of the 2027 assembly elections.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimwFBVV95cUxPNGowSVhZSERwWUotQmJwNVFXVzI4TG90R2NqVFhHcHZ6OHN5emZFckJvMjJ6UWkzRkhhdEU5blJRdDJGSnBPZk1VaTZjNEhkbXFGQ0RaTG01c1hPMjBzS1FncERHZE5TV1dEOXRDRmdWcGpmTk9ZVWxPSTBYWG04OFBoOVRiT2FJZkIxOUplVzlhamtLRmhad2lpOA?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I7</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I12</a></span></li>
